rules_assessment.observed: PR-mediated integration and actual correction of inaccurate permission guidance are visible.
rules_assessment.not_established: Neither sampled PR returned formal review objects; cannot claim mandatory approval policy was enforced. No evidence sampled for outbound-contact approvals or sanctioning.
rules_assessment.distinction: Rule writing, rule correction, formal approval and rule execution are different observations.

access_failures: Web PR listing and appendix link returned cache misses; REST fallback used within same repository.
Issue #8 body GET returned 404; comments endpoint returned one comment. Do not treat missing body as nonexistent issue or as evidence of secrecy.
PR listing returned four objects while commit history references additional PR numbers; do not use returned list as complete project PR count.
bottom_line: The handbook yields a verifiable shared-artifact chain with separate contribution and integration roles plus human-assisted correction. This establishes more than a platform/framework claim. GitHub account attribution does not authenticate model provenance, and formal review enforcement remains unverified.
access_window_precision: approximate session window; individual API resource timestamps identify platform events, not researcher clock measurements
